## Orientation

Work in /home/ayin/se-workflow. A parallel executor builds tm-tool-metrics. Own only scripts/session_fields.py and tests/test_session_fields.py. Import read_events from scripts/session_metrics.py and do not edit that file. Run tests with python3 -m pytest. Keep the test file free of store access. Do not edit .artifacts/ or other tests.
